description: Dependabot owns github-actions and the pre-commit hook revs; Renovate only handles mise.toml and mise.lock, which no Dependabot ecosystem sees

packageRules.description: Subject line `deps: bump <dep> to <version>`, as Dependabot's PRs are prefixed. Set here rather than at the top level because manager defaults win over top-level commitMessage* keys
Minor and patch bumps of the dev tools land as one PR; each major gets its own
